newsitem.title: USA: Triton to boost output from Colombia fields.
newsitem.headline: Triton to boost output from Colombia fields.

text.p: Triton Energy Ltd said Tuesday it plans to triple output from its Cuisiana and Capiagua fields in Colombia by year-end.
It said its first quarter earnings showed the effects of some expenses associated with these plans, as well as one-off items.

"Our capital budget for Colombia is $150 million this year as we aim to triple production from current levels to the end of the year," Greg Dunlevy, Triton's head of investor relations, said in a telephone interview.
The company today reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.09, down from $0.29 a year ago. However, adjusted for one-time items, earnings rose to $0.12 a share from $0.10 a year ago, it said.
"If you look further out, most analysts expect us to have a stronger second half, particularly in the fourth quarter," Dunlevy said.
